correctness.rationale: Exhaustively and independently checked the supplied JSON as data. The canonical ordering is the lexicographically least sorted sequence of base-3 column codes under row permutations. Explicitly expanded every representative under both row and column permutations, marking all 531441 labeled profiles with no intersection between representative orbits. Checked each positive unique support and exact normalization with cleared integer denominators; checked the six expected envy inequalities, EFX by removal of each comparison bundle's least-valued good for the evaluating agent, and nondomination against the own-utility vectors of all 81 complete allocations. All 5053 witnesses pass, including the illustrative lottery; 392 profiles have all three levels in every row, and the support histogram is (1123,2091,1772,67). Relabeling preserves every condition, so this is exhaustive for the claimed finite domain. Replay: `python3 /workspace/branches/frozen_replay.py 3`.
residual_risks: This proves existence on the specified alphabet only. The 67 four-point certificates do not show that any profile requires four. Deterministic PO does not imply fractional PO.

evidence: Bu et al. prove a positive result with stronger fractional PO and more agents, but the singleton alphabet is bi-valued.

Panchapakesan–Vaish have a positive three-agent result for lexicographic goods, not the fixed additive alphabet. Aziz rules out the general positive-additive guarantee at this market size, with values outside {1,2,3}.
broader_coverage.reasoning: None of these larger theorems dominates all of the frozen hypotheses and conclusion simultaneously; in particular, fractional PO on a narrower valuation class does not cover this theorem.

value.rationale: The first consecutive positive integer alphabet beyond the known bi-valued guarantee settles a meaningful compatibility boundary in the same small market that already permits impossibility. The comparison with the nearby {1,3,4} counterexample shows that the actual levels, not just their cardinality, matter. The certificate gives an exact finite benchmark for identifying which domains allow ex-ante fairness with complete EFX/PO support, plus a usable uniform support bound.
residual_risks: No threshold is proved for general triples of real values or more goods, and there is no optimality claim for the support bound.
